name: Multi-select
purpose: Let a person pick several options from a searchable list and see what they picked.
description: A labelled combobox whose choices become removable chips. The form sends the chosen options as a list.

label.description: What the field asks for. It names the control and, with no name prop, the key its value is sent under.

name.description: The key the value is sent under, such as "email". Left out, it is the label in camelCase: "Work email" is sent as workEmail.

options.description: The choices a person searches, in display order.

values.description: Options chosen at the start. Each must be one of the options.

placeholder.description: A prompt to type, shown until a person does.

required.description: The form cannot be sent until a person chooses at least one option.

hint.description: Help that stays under the field and is read with it, such as a format or a limit.

error.description: A problem with the value, shown under the field and announced with it. It marks the field invalid.
